Tebex Minecraft plugin (Folia build)
====================================

Component: tebex-folia-*.jar (installed as plugins/tebex.jar)
Upstream:  https://github.com/tebexio/Tebex-Minecraft
License:   GNU General Public License v3.0 (see LICENSE-GPLv3.txt)
Copyright: Tebex Ltd and contributors

YaPcore does not modify this jar. It is an optional third-party plugin for
web-store command delivery on Hub (YaP-Folia). Fetch with:

  ./scripts/fetch-tebex.sh

Source code corresponding to the binary is available from the upstream GitHub
repository and release tags. If you redistribute a YaPcore package that includes
this jar, you must also provide recipients with GPLv3 rights to the Tebex plugin
(include this NOTICE + LICENSE, and a pointer to source).

YaPcore first-party code is GPLv3 — same license family as this Tebex plugin.
See docs/start/LICENSING.md and third-party/tebex/LICENSE-GPLv3.txt.
